query:
SELECT p.title, p.slug, COUNT(pt.tagId) as tag_count
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN projectTags pt ON p.id = pt.projectId
WHERE p.discipline = 'scenic_design' 
AND p.status = 'published'
AND p.seoKeywords IS NOT NULL
AND p.seoKeywords != ''
GROUP BY p.id, p.title, p.slug
ORDER BY tag_count ASC, p.year DESC;
